description: This Java class provides utility methods for constructing file paths for images related to products, manufacturers, store logos, and properties within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ImageFilePathUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing image file paths for various content types in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: buildStaticImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for static images used by the image servlet.

methods.name: buildManufacturerImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for manufacturer images.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for product images using Product object.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a default product image file path using SKU.

methods.name: buildLargeProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for large product images.

methods.name: buildStoreLogoFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for store logo images.

methods.name: buildProductPropertyImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for product property images.
